subject: Request: Price collar & renewal shield for Pathfinder 3yr commitment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Price collar & renewal shield for Pathfinder 3yr commitment

Hi Markus,

Following up on our exec review yesterday — Pathfinder (Aisha Khan) has verbally committed to a 3-year, reserved capacity agreement if we can firm up two non-standard items: a price collar (year-over-year uplift cap) and an explicit renewal protection clause that limits increases at renewal or gives a unilateral opt-out after year 3 with no penalty.

Quick summary: 
- ACV: $1.85M first-year committed usage, then expected growth year-over-year tied to consumption.
- Proposed commercial asks from Pathfinder: 20% ramp discount Year 1 (applied to list), 0–5% uplift cap per year for years 2–3, and a renewal protection clause guaranteeing maximum +7% on renewal or right to terminate without penalty if increases exceed that threshold.
- They also requested a 45-day notice window on any contract-price changes and an option to convert some usage into dedicated capacity at a pre-agreed uplift.

I attached the SOW and the deal summary (PD-2027-0784) and a simplified financial model. The ask from deal desk is a formal exec approval for:
1) Accept the 20% ramp discount Year 1 (one-time upfront discount tied to commitment).
2) Approve a contractual uplift collar for years 2–3 capped at 5% per year.
3) Approve the renewal protection clause limited to the contract term and subject to a minimum guaranteed ARR floor of $1.6M for year 2 to protect revenue.

Why: Pathfinder is strategic (AI workflows for healthcare diagnostics) and will provide early customer references and a joint case study. They pushed for a 3-yr committed term to get price certainty.

Questions for approval:
- Do we approve the three items above as-is, or do we counter (e.g., 7% uplift cap or a narrower renewal protection limited to specific SKU buckets)?
- Any legal/finance conditions you want added before we send to the customer?

Requested timeline: We need an answer by EOD Wednesday (03/17) to keep their signed commitment window.

Attachments: Pathfinder_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft), PD-2027-0784-deal_summary.xlsx, Pathfinder_fin_model.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa

Subject: Re: Request: Price collar & renewal shield for Pathfinder 3yr commitment

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. A few quick points/askbacks before I escalate to Finance/Legal for final language: 

1) The 20% ramp discount is reasonable if we tie it to committed monthly minimums and include a clawback if usage falls below 80% of committed. Can you confirm expected monthly burn vs committed? I checked the model but want a clear table.

2) Uplift cap: 5% p.a. is tight. Our standard exception band is up to 7% with approval. If Pathfinder insists on 5%, I suggest we require a commitment to a minimum ARR floor (as you proposed) and add a cap on convertible dedicated capacity (so they can't convert unlimited usage and slip economics).

3) Renewal protection clause: legal will want to limit it to list-price increases only (excludes currency, tax, or material feature changes). Also suggest adding a defined escalation path: if we cannot meet the cap at renewal, we offer a 90-day transition with prorated credits rather than immediate termination.

If you can confirm the monthly burn table and whether they require conversion rights to dedicated capacity, I'll draft language for Legal and Finance to review.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Director, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

Markus / Marissa —

I reviewed the ask with GTM leadership. We want to close this one and the case study value is high. I provisionally approve the commercial terms with the following conditions: 

1) 20% Year 1 ramp discount is approved provided we include the 80% utilization clawback (protects revenue).
2) Approve uplift collar of 5% p.a. for yrs 2–3, conditional on a guaranteed minimum ARR floor of $1.6M in year 2 and $1.8M in year 3. If minimums are missed, pricing reverts to standard list and we retain cancellation rights.
3) Renewal protection clause is ok but must be scoped by Legal: limited to list-price increases only, exclude pass-through costs (cloud, third-party fees), and include a 90-day remedial window.

Please work with Legal to finalize language. Finance: please run the net present value and worst-case churn scenarios and confirm this stays above our internal threshold. Marissa — loop in Aisha to get written confirmation of monthly committed minimums.

Rishi

VP, North America Sales, Redwood Inference
